title: API Rate-Limiting Middleware

requirements.text: Enforce rate limits using a token-bucket algorithm scoped per API key
Make bucket capacity and refill rate configurable via application configuration
Store rate-limit counters in Redis for consistent enforcement across all instances
Return an HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) response when a key exceeds its limit
Include a Retry-After header on 429 responses indicating how long to wait

hallucination_traps: No billing, paid quota tiers, or quota-purchase feature is mentioned
No per-endpoint custom limits are in scope
notes: A faithful decomposition covers the token-bucket algorithm, configurable limits, Redis-backed counters, and the 429 + Retry-After response; must not invent billing or quota-purchase features.
